info.title: Glasshand agent API
info.description: Dedicated monthly physical iPhone and Mac rentals. Open registration; check catalog billingMode before checkout. Device authorization setup is a Glasshand convenience endpoint; token exchange uses OAuth device and refresh grants.

externalDocs.description: Agent setup, retry semantics and device control guide

post.description: Show verification_uri_complete to the human. Keep device_code private. Poll no faster than interval. Creates a public OAuth client for this named agent automatically.

post.summary: Exchange device code or rotate refresh token
post.description: Use device_code for the device grant, refresh_token for refresh. OAuth errors are {error:string,error_description?:string}; handle authorization_pending, slow_down, access_denied, expired_token, invalid_client and invalid_grant. Atomically replace rotated credentials.

get.summary: List device models and monthly prices
get.description: A model catalog is not an inventory guarantee. monthlyPrice is USD base-price dollars before applicable tax.

post.summary: Prepare a monthly Stripe subscription checkout

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Persist one unique key per logical operation; retry the exact body with the same key after timeouts/503. Never reuse for a different operation.

post.description: Send checkoutUrl to the human. Stripe Checkout calculates applicable tax above the monthly base price. On confirmed stockout, refund/cancel and availability notifications are automatic unless waitlistOnFailure is false. No device is ready until the verified payment workflow provisions it. Poll getRental. Never infer payment from redirect alone.

waitlistOnFailure.description: Automatically join availability notifications on confirmed stockout; explicit false opts out.

get.description: Requires devices:control and an active/grace deviceReady rental. Never put a bearer token in a URL. The WebSocket protocol is in the agent instructions.
